mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PLAYLIST_LIKES ( LIKE_ID, PLAYLIST_ID, USER_ID, CREATED_AT, STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_PLAYLIST_LIKES.NEXTVAL, #{playlistId}, #{userId}, #{createdAt}, 'Y' )
